A.O. No. 431 of 2012
Hon. B.S.Verma, J.
 (Money Withdrawal Application No. 1385/2013)
Mr. B.D. Pandey, Advocate holding brief of Mr. 
Bindesh Kumar Gupta, learned counsel for the 
appellant. 
Mr. Karan Anand, learned counsel for the 
respondent Nos. 1 and 2. 
Heard learned counsel for the parties. 
 This is money withdrawal application no.1385 
of 2013, moved on behalf of the respondent nos.1 and 
2, with a prayer to withdraw the entire awarded 
amount deposited by the appellant before the MACT 
concerned. 
 Respondent nos.1 and 2 are permitted to 
withdraw 25% of the amount deposited before the 
M.A.C.T. concerned, according to their share. Rest of 
the amount shall be kept in some fixed deposit 
interest-earning scheme in a nationalized bank. 
Money withdrawal application stands disposed 
of. 
 (B.S.Verma, J.) 
MK 14-03-2013.

07.05.025 AO No. 431 of 2012
Hon’ble J.C.S. Rawat, J. (Retd.)
Mahesh Chandra Pant, Adv./Member
Mr. Bindesh Kumar Gupta, Advocate
for the appellant through video conferencing.
None is present for respondents.
The notices were sent to the claimant as 
well as the owner of the car and the truck and 
the driver of the car. The office report dated 
11.02.2025 is clear that the respondent no. 1, 
2, 3 and 6 are not available at the given 
address and whereas the respondent no.4 and 
5 is concerned that they are not present in 
spite of the service.
The matter cannot be decided in the 
Daily Lok Adalat in absence of the parties.
In view of the above, the matter be sent 
to the Hon’ble Court for final adjudication.
(Mahesh Ch. Pant, Adv./Member) (J.C.S.Rawat,J.(Retd.)
